description: Economics spin skeleton — proves the wiring, not a real economic model yet. Watches city-buildings' building_position and city-roads' road_network (no enumeration, pure subscribe-by-name) and publishes back onto each building's OWN entity: building_road_distance_m/building_nearest_road_name (real, static, distance to the nearest real road node), and building_traffic_visits_count (a real counter of how often any other entity's position comes within range, with a per-mover cooldown). Has no idea whether city-roads/city-buildings/physics-test are even running.
author: prackoreal
